summary: Google DeepMind describes its internal 'AI Control Roadmap' framework for monitoring and constraining potentially misaligned AI agents and publishes a related policy paper for policymakers.

practices.reason: The stated metrics (coverage, recall, time-to-response) and MITRE ATT&CK-based threat taxonomy give a concrete framework an engineering team could adapt to measure agent monitoring effectiveness.
practices.quote: we constantly measure performance across three critical metrics: coverage (the fraction of traffic monitored), recall (the fraction of misaligned behaviors caught), and time-to-response.

practices.reason: Using a separate trusted model as a real-time supervisor over an agent's reasoning and actions is a concrete architectural pattern for agent deployments, though described only at the internal-prototype level.
practices.quote: We use other, trusted AI systems as "supervisors" to constantly review a working agent's reasoning, actions and plans to see if it is going off track.
